audience: email marketers who report on lists and campaigns in Campaign Monitor

useCases.title: Track the growth and churn of one list
useCases.text: List the clients, then the lists of one client. Read the active, unsubscribed and bounced totals and the growth figures.

useCases.title: Report on a sent campaign
useCases.text: List the sent campaigns of a client. Then read the summary of one campaign and the links its readers clicked.

useCases.title: Check the state of one subscriber
useCases.text: List the lists of a client to find a list id. Then look up one subscriber by email to read the state and custom fields.

useCases.title: Review the suppressed addresses
useCases.text: List the email addresses that a client has suppressed, with the date and reason for each.

useCases.title: Check scheduled sends and drafts
useCases.text: List the scheduled campaigns and the draft campaigns of one client before the next send.

useCases.title: Find the bounced subscribers of a list
useCases.text: List the bounced subscribers of one list, with the bounce type and date.
